d: In this episode of we will discuss the reunion of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) in Punjab. We will discuss the key announcements made at the joint press conference and trace the history of the Akali Dal and its relationship with the BJP. Why did the two parties come together in the first place, and why did their decades-old alliance break in 2020? What has changed politically since then, and which party needs the alliance more today?
